summary: Frontend-only verification of R3-1 (TabBar repo quick-switch polish), R6 (PrMiniGuide + ship status label unification), ship-failure toast Retry, and ShipConfirmModal error-phase Retry button. R6 items and Retry are fully working live. R3-1 UI changes are ONLY covered by unit tests — <TabBar /> is not rendered anywhere in the running app (only its helper exports are consumed), so end users never see the new owner/repo labels or connection dots in production. Live regression smoke passed: login works, dashboard renders without page errors, ShipConfirmModal opens/closes cleanly.

ui_bugs.issue: R3-1 quick-switch polish (owner/repo label + connection dot) only exists in TabBar.jsx's <Tab> sub-component, and <TabBar /> is not rendered anywhere in the running app. Live app uses <ProjectSwitcher /> (dropdown) mounted via Dashboard.jsx.projectSwitcherSlot instead. The R3-1 change therefore does not reach end users. Unit tests still pass because they mount <TabBar /> directly.

action_items: Decide whether R3-1 was intended for the legacy <TabBar /> (needs remount above chat panel) OR for the live <ProjectSwitcher /> component. If the latter, port the owner/repo label + connection dot (data-testid=tab-{project_id} / tab-{project_id}-connection-dot) into ProjectSwitcher.jsx so users actually see it.
Optional: delete or clearly mark TabBar.jsx as legacy if ProjectSwitcher is now canonical, to avoid future R-round work landing in a dead component.
critical_code_review_comments: R3-1 acceptance test regressed to unit-test-only coverage because <TabBar /> has zero JSX call sites in the production tree — greppable evidence: `grep -rn '<TabBar' src/` returns only test files. The problem statement's stated selectors (tab-{project_id}, tab-{project_id}-connection-dot) do not appear in the live DOM after login for either 1-project or many-project users.
PrMiniGuide, Toast string-arg fix, ShipConfirmModal error-phase Retry, and the shared shipStatus.js 'Rolled back' label are all correctly wired and verified live — good work on these.

Minor: <PrMiniGuide /> in ShipConfirmModal is rendered in the 'confirm' phase only (line 488) — if a user first arrives at ship via the loop-engine 'shipped' event (skips confirm), they won't have seen the guide. Ship-approval flows through ShipDialog still cover this because canShip is set there, so overall FTUX is still met.
TabBar.jsx line 165: Tab sub-component receives repoLabel/wired props but is only reachable when <TabBar /> is mounted — see main finding above.

success_rate.backend: N/A (not tested this round per request)
success_rate.frontend: 80% (4/5 live-verifiable items pass; R3-1 not reachable in live UI)

context_for_next_testing_agent: R6 PrMiniGuide is verified via aurem:open-ship-modal event → guide appears, has text 'pull request'/'Merge'/'live on your site', dismiss X sets localStorage aurem_pr_mini_guide_seen_v1=1, subsequent modal opens do NOT re-show it. ShipConfirmModal error phase correctly shows ship-modal-retry alongside ship-modal-close-final. TaskProgressCard/ShipConfirmModal/LoopLiveFeed all say 'Rolled back' via shared lib/shipStatus.js — no 'Reverted' string remains in production render paths. The one gap: R3-1 TabBar polish lives only in unit tests; live app uses ProjectSwitcher dropdown. Screenshot at .screenshots/logged_in.jpeg shows the live dashboard chrome for reference.
rca of the issue: R3-1: main agent modified frontend/src/components/TabBar.jsx which was previously the tab strip above the chat panel, but the app migrated to <ProjectSwitcher /> (dashboard/v2/ProjectSwitcher.jsx) mounted through TopBar.projectSwitcherSlot at some earlier point. Only TabBar's non-JSX exports (getActiveProjectId/setActiveProjectId/useActiveProject) are still consumed. Fix path: either remount <TabBar /> in TopBar, OR replicate the label+dot changes into ProjectSwitcher.jsx and add matching testids.
